# Ray Cast Hit Position

Source: [wiki article 4730](../archive/4730.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Ray Cast Hit Position](../../api/values/ray-cast-hit-position.md).

<a id="wiki-4730-n1"></a>

- No hit returns end position; raycasts ignore Phased Out players.

<a id="wiki-4730-n2"></a>

- Player position arguments resolve two meters above feet; excluded players take precedence over included players.

<a id="wiki-4730-n3"></a>

- Player-owned objects toggle includes barriers/turrets.
